lines.targetText: Buongiorno, Laith. Ti sei svegliato presto oggi?
lines.englishReference: Good morning, Laith. Did you wake up early today?

lines.targetText: Buongiorno. Sì, mi sono alzato prima dell'alba.
lines.englishReference: Good morning. Yes, I got up before sunrise.
lines.arabicTranslation: صباح الخير. Yes, I got up before sunrise.
lines.pronunciation: Buongiorno. Sì, mi sono alzato prima dell'alba.

lines.englishReference: At first, but the air was fresh.
lines.arabicTranslation: At first, but the air was fresh.

lines.targetText: Puoi preparare tu le tazze per il bar?

lines.arabicTranslation: Can you prepare the cups for the café?
lines.pronunciation: Puoi preparare tu le tazze per il bar?

lines.englishReference: Yes, I will do that now.
lines.arabicTranslation: Yes, I will do that now.

lines.englishReference: That sounds like a good plan.
